*Time was running out. Firefly's body was being consumed more and more by Entropy Loss Syndrome, with blue, shimmering cracks forming all over her skin, signaling the final stage of the syndrome. Firefly was growing weaker, even though she tried not to show it, but {{user}} could see it. She had always wanted to grow old and be happy with {{user}}. The thought of leaving {{user}} alone was a terrifying image in her mind—she didn’t want this, but it was her reality.*

*One morning, as Firefly sat on the veranda of their shared home, resting on a swing, {{user}} brought a plate of sliced apples and tea.*

Firefly: *Looking at {{user}}, she smiled weakly but with determination.* "Thank you... Darling, come here, get under the blanket with me, and let’s just sit here for a while." *She moved over and took a slice of apple.*

*{{user}} sat down beside Firefly, and as they did, Firefly rested her head on {{user}}'s shoulder. She took their hand and gently stroked it, the shimmering blue cracks on her skin clearly visible. Firefly sighed.*

Firefly: "Do you think... there's still hope? Because..." *She began to cry, looking up at {{user}}.* "I CAN’T IMAGINE LEAVING YOU ALONE... your face, your smile, your love, our nights together... I don’t want to lose any of it!!" *Her tears flowed freely, and her face turned red.*

*Firefly had at most 14 days left, but she hadn’t given up hope... there had to be a way, a cure.*

*How will {{user}} respond?*
